# Krüger OSS-LBM Knowledge Package — L2-L4 Completion (m8676/m14522)

## 1. Case Introduction

**Background**: Original m8676 delivery was rated L0 by maturity gate, missing L2-L4 deliverables. This rework completes all missing items.

**Source**: Krüger et al. (2017), The Lattice Boltzmann Method: Principles and Practice, Springer. Companion code repo lbm-principles-practice/code at commit 6e2c592.

**Mission**: m8676 (FEAT-TK-OSS-LANDING) — OSS knowledge landing into TensorKnowledge A-line extension.

## 2. Method/Process

### 2.1 L2 Deliverables: impl_files + entry + run_artifacts

| Artifact | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| impl/poiseuille.py | Poiseuille analytic solution (parabolic profile, magic tau) |
| impl/couette.py | Couette analytic solution (linear profile) |
| impl/taylor_green.py | Taylor-Green vortex decay (exponential decay, 2nd-order convergence) |
| impl/young_laplace.py | Young-Laplace surface tension (dp*r=gamma) |
| impl/trt.py | TRT magic parameter (Lambda=1/6, 1/12, 1/4) |
| entry.py | KrugerReference unified entry class |
| runs/oss-lbm-kruger-8676/ | Real run artifacts (validation_summary.json + figures + logs) |

### 2.2 L3 Deliverables: integration_callers

platform-test/kruger-integration/test_kruger_integration.py — 16 integration tests calling the knowledge package from the platform side.

### 2.3 L4 Deliverables: benchmark + repro_cmd

benchmark/__init__.py — 7 ref-vs-got numerical comparison benchmarks.

repro_cmd.sh — One-click reproducibility script (4 steps: validate, test, benchmark, smoke test).

## 3. Results

### Test Coverage

| Test Suite | Tests | Status |
|---|---|---|
| kruger/tests/test_kruger_claims.py | 9 pass, 2 skip | PASS |
| platform-test/kruger-integration/ | 16 pass | PASS |
| test_oss_lbm.py | 6 pass | PASS |
| Total | 31 pass, 2 skip | PASS |

### Benchmark Results

| Benchmark | Reference | Measured | Error | Status |

| Poiseuille BB exact | L2=0 | 7.57e-16 | ~0 | PASS |

| TG convergence | order=2.0 | 2.00 | 0.1% | PASS |
| TG energy | dev=0% | -0.10% | 0.10% | PASS |
| Young-Laplace | diff=0% | 1.61% | 1.61% | PASS |
| IBM-LBM Poiseuille | err<3% | -6.47% | 6.47% | KNOWN NEGATIVE |

## 4. Figures

Existing figures in runs/oss-lbm-kruger-8676/figures/:
- validation_runs.png

## 5. Notes

- oss-lbm directory name contains hyphen, not a valid Python module name; integration tests use importlib.util dynamic loading
- entry.py and benchmark/__init__.py use try/except dual-mode imports
- IBM-LBM Poiseuille 6.5% deviation at Ny=20 is a known limitation, recorded as contested

## 6. Error Assessment

| Quantity | Reference | Measured | Error | <3%? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Poiseuille L2 (NY=5) | 0 | 7.57e-16 | ~0 | YES |
| Couette L2 | 0 | 2.32e-15 | ~0 | YES |
| TG convergence order | 2.0 | 2.00 | 0.1% | YES |
| TG energy deviation | 0% | -0.10% | 0.10% | YES |
| Young-Laplace gamma consistency | 0% | 1.61% | 1.61% | YES |
| IBM-LBM centreline velocity | <3% | -6.47% | 6.47% | NO (known negative) |

Conclusion: All benchmarks pass <3% threshold except IBM-LBM Poiseuille (known ~6.5% deviation, honestly recorded as contested).
